question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a purple ball, and Claire has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Claire and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) purple ball
(C) pink ball
solution:
Ball color columns: Alice | Bob | Claire
Initial: silver | purple | pink
1. Alice ↔ Claire: pink | purple | silver
2. Alice ↔ Bob: purple | pink | silver
3. Claire ↔ Bob: purple | silver | pink
Alice has the purple ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
